Sultan Hanafi Royal Schools

A Word of Welcome

On behalf of the Board of Trustees and every member of the Sultan Hanafi Royal Schools community, it is our honour to welcome you to this Combined Graduation Ceremony for the Class of 2026. Since our doors opened in Ikorodu in December 2017, we have held to a single conviction: that a child’s secular education and their grounding in Islamic and Arabic learning need not stand apart.

Building the Future Ummah Through Holistic Education

Today’s graduates — from our youngest Primary School leavers to our Qur’an College ḥuffāẓ — represent the full breadth of that vision. To our parents, guardians and distinguished guests: thank you for entrusting us with these years, and for joining us as we celebrate them.

The Board of Trustees

A Word from the Chief Executive Director

A combined ceremony such as this is also, I think, a statement about who we are. We have always resisted the idea that a strong Qur’an memorisation pathway and a rigorous secular curriculum are two different projects running side by side.

At Sultan Hanafi Royal Schools they are one project, and today’s graduates are its clearest evidence.

Dr. Zakariya Olanrewaju Anofi Chief Executive Director
